question: About the Charlotte Family's 26th son, Charlotte Bavarois' hat has net glasses on it, is it like one of those old so-called "mysterious net" hats? -
answer: You've got it right! That's correct, it's from a long time ago. When I was a child, all the young boys were wearing these "mysterious net" hats. Upon looking it up, it appears their correct name is "mesh" hats. I wonder if those caps can be still found around. It made me happy you noticed it. They're cool, aren't they?
